title: "Fig2d"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-12"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(magrittr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

##所有质谱文件形成List

PTMnames <- c('Ac','Ub','Ma','Sc','Cr')

readpath_PTM <- 'C:/Users/lihai/Desktop/Fig_2d/11762852/'

FinnalOriginal_List <- list()

savepath <- 'C:/Users/lihai/Desktop/Fig_2d/pathway/'

for (i in 1:length(PTMnames)) {
  
  readpath <- paste(readpath_PTM,PTMnames[i],'.xlsx',sep = '')
  
  PTM <- read_excel(readpath,sheet = 3)
  
  colnames(PTM) <- PTM[1,]
  
  PTM <- PTM[-1,]
  
  PTM_Fiannal <- data.frame(PTM[,1:5],PTM[,42:53])
  
  FinnalOriginal_List <- c(FinnalOriginal_List,list(PTM_Fiannal))
  
}

readpath_protein <- paste(readpath_PTM,'Protein.xlsx',sep = '')

proteinList <- read_excel(readpath_protein,sheet = 3)

proteinList_Fiannal <- data.frame(proteinList[,1:5],proteinList[,65:76])

FinnalOriginal_List <- c(FinnalOriginal_List,list(proteinList_Fiannal))

names_document <- c('Ac','Ub','Ma','Sc','Cr','Protein')

#kegg

KOannotation <- read.delim("C:/Users/lihai/Desktop/Fig_2d/KOannotation.tsv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

KOannotation1 <- separate(KOannotation, col = 1, into =c('aaa','Gene','bbbb'), sep = "[|]", remove = FALSE)

KOannotation_final <- KOannotation1[,c(3,5,6:7)]

###通路蛋白顺序
proteinOrder <- read_excel('C:/Users/lihai/Desktop/Fig_2d/G+TCA.xlsx',col_names = F)

colnames(proteinOrder) <- c('KOnumber','ProteinID','ProteinName')

#####输入map号，输出输入通路的所有修饰表达矩阵和热图,储存位置为mapname/修饰名_mapdata.csv,四组对比

##需求：按照顺序排序，蛋白不同的地方要有break

#筛选proteinOrder中所有的修饰情况

for (i in 1:length(FinnalOriginal_List)) {
  
  PTMdata <- FinnalOriginal_List[[i]][,-(3:5)]
  
  PTMdata_filter <- PTMdata[which(PTMdata$Protein.accession %in% proteinOrder$ProteinID),]
  
  colnames(PTMdata_filter)[1] <- 'ProteinID'
  
  PTMdata_filter <- merge(PTMdata_filter,proteinOrder,by = 'ProteinID',all.x = T)#添加新列ProteinNames
  
  PTMdata_filter <- PTMdata_filter[order(factor(PTMdata_filter$ProteinID,levels=c(proteinOrder$ProteinID))),] ##按照特定顺序排序
  
  #去除表达量在所有组中都为NA的位点，这种位点只检测到但没有定量
  
  if(sum(apply(PTMdata_filter,1,function(x) sum(is.na(x)) == 12)) != 0){
    
    PTMdata_filter <- PTMdata_filter[-which(apply(PTMdata_filter,1,function(x) sum(is.na(x)) == 12)),]}
  
  ##meanTotalData <- data.frame(ProteinSiteID = paste(PTMdata_filter$ProteinName,PTMdata_filter$Position,sep = '_'))
  
  newData <- data.frame(ProteinID = unique(PTMdata_filter$ProteinName))
  
  for (a in seq(3,12,3)) {
    
    groupData <- data.frame(PTMdata_filter[,1:2],PTMdata_filter$KOnumber,PTMdata_filter$ProteinName,PTMdata_filter[,a:c(a+2)])
    
    colnames(groupData)[3:4] <- c('KOnumber','ProteinName')
    
    groupData[,5:7] <- as.data.frame(apply(groupData[,5:7],2,as.numeric))#将数据转换为数值型
    
    meanData <- apply(groupData[,5:7],1,function(x){
      
      if(sum(is.na(x)) == 3){NA}else{
        
        if(sum(is.na(x)) == 2){sum(x[-which(is.na(x))]) / 1}else{
          
          if(sum(is.na(x)) == 1){sum(x[-which(is.na(x))]) / 2}else{
            
            sum(x) / 3
            
          }
          
        }
        
      }
      
    })%>%as.data.frame() ###根据NA的个数的情况，来算平均值
    
    colnames(meanData) <- str_sub(colnames(groupData)[5],1,6)##取前6个字符作为行名
    
    groupData <- cbind(groupData,meanData)
    
    ##对每个蛋白的所有位点取表达量平均值
    
    prob <- c()
    
    for (b in 1:nrow(newData)) {
      
      filter_groupData <- filter(groupData,ProteinName == newData[b,1])
      
      filter_groupData[is.na(filter_groupData)] <- 0
      
      prob <- append(prob,(sum(filter_groupData[,8]) / nrow(filter_groupData)))
      
    }
    
    prob <- as.data.frame(prob)
    
    colnames(prob) <- colnames(meanData)
    
    newData <- cbind(newData,prob)
    
  }
  
  
  rownames(newData) <- newData[,1]
  
  newData <- newData[,-1]
  
  ##更换列顺序
  
  newData <- data.frame(newData[,3:4],newData[,1:2])
  
  #热图
  
  library(ggsci)
  
  savepath_heatmap1 <-  paste(savepath,names_document[i],'_PTMheatmap无聚类.pdf',sep = '')
  
  pheatmap(newData,filename = savepath_heatmap1,cluster_cols = FALSE,cluster_rows = F,scale='row',
           color = colorRampPalette(c(pal_gsea()(10)[2],'white',pal_gsea()(10)[10]))(50),
           cellwidth = 30,cellheight = 10,na_col = 'white',fontsize_row = 5,
           fontsize_number = 5,border_color = 'white')
  
  
  savepath_heatmap2 <-  paste(savepath,'/',names_document[i],'_PTMheatmap.pdf',sep = '')
  
  pheatmap(newData,filename = savepath_heatmap2,cluster_cols = FALSE,cluster_rows = T,scale='row',
           color = colorRampPalette(c(pal_gsea()(10)[2],'white',pal_gsea()(10)[10]))(50),
           cellwidth = 30,cellheight = 10,na_col = 'white',fontsize_row = 5,
           fontsize_number = 5,border_color = 'white')
  
}


library(RColorBrewer)
display.brewer.all(type="div")



```
